rationale: Lactate depleted; switch to abundant L-arabinose (pentose fermentation) with arginine as nitrogen source. Ferment to butyrate, acetate, CO2, formate via mixed-acid pathway. Arabinose at 15 mmol/gDW/h is realistic for pentose uptake; arginine at 2.5 provides N and supplemental C. Growth rate 0.48 /h is typical for Roseburia on arabinose in anaerobic batch culture.
